prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Conroe, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1261; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on the recording, if that's all right. I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where the collision happened?

A: It was in a parking lot in Conroe, Texas, at a shopping center. I was pulling out of a parking space near the main entrance.

Q: What happened just before the impact?

A: I was backing out slowly, checking my mirrors. A pickup came down the lane fairly fast and clipped the rear quarter panel of my car. I slammed on the brakes, but it was too late.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did you feel any injury at the time?

A: Not right away. I grabbed the steering wheel when I braked hard, and my left wrist took most of the force. By the next morning it was swollen and I couldn't grip anything.

Q: Have you received medical treatment?

A: Yes. I went to urgent care and they X-rayed it. The doctor said it was a fracture of the wrist, and I've been wearing a splint and going to follow-up appointments.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the accident?

A: Only that the other driver told the officer at the scene that she didn't see my car. I was stopped and signaling before the impact, and I'd like that noted.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.

A: Thank you.
